title: Route 53 and CloudFront: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: Route fifty three is a phone directory for your sites. CloudFront keeps copies near your visitors. Together, they make sites fast.

scenes.heading: The library directory
scenes.narration: Two services, two jobs. Route fifty three turns names into addresses. An alias record is the only way to point a root domain at an A W S resource. CloudFront caches copies at edge locations. It's pull based, so the first visitor fetches the file.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three traps. You can't use a C N A M E at the root. It caches after the first request. It also does health checks.

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.cta: Try the Courseiva Route 53 and CloudFront lab
scenes.narration: So, to recap. Use an alias for the root domain. CloudFront caches at the edge. It fills the cache on first request. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva Route 53 and CloudFront lab.
